title: HUD Coins stays at 0/5 after collecting a coin by dash
observed: After dash-right at tick 2, state shows coins=1 and Score 100, but the HUD still reads 'Coins 0/5'.
expected: HUD shows current values: Coins should read 1/5 right after the coin is collected.

title: HUD Time lags one tick behind the timer after resuming from pause
observed: After pause+right then click:btn-resume, state timeLeft is 299 but the HUD reads 'Time 300'.
expected: HUD shows the current timer value (ticks left), i.e. 299 once the running tick has dropped the timer.

title: Restart level from pause leaves the game paused instead of running
observed: After pause then click:btn-restart, state resets to score 0/lives 3/time 300 but mode stays 'paused' and the pause menu remains; further waits change nothing.
expected: Restart level puts the level back to its starting state and the game is running again straight away (mode 'playing').

title: Spikes subtract 500 from score 100 and wrap to 65136
observed: Stepping on spikes with score 100 sets score to 65136 (unsigned underflow of 100-500) and lives drop to 2.
expected: Spikes cost 500 points with the score floored at 0, so score should be 0 and lives 2.

title: Dash and step pressed in same tick both move the player (3 tiles)
observed: Tick dash-right+right moves the player from (1,1) to (4,1): a 2-tile dash plus a 1-tile step in one tick.
expected: Only the last movement key counts; the player makes at most one move (a step or a dash) per tick, so the player should end at (2,1).

title: Score goes negative (-300) after spikes underflow
observed: After the spike hit the score is 65136 and then shows -300 in the HUD at tick 5 (pause+right) and stays negative on resume.
expected: Score is never negative; spikes floor the score at 0 and it must stay within 0..999,999.

title: Spikes at score 100 make score jump to 65136, then go negative (-300)
observed: At tick 2 a spike hit with score 100 raised the score to 65136 instead of flooring at 0. Later, at tick 5, the score fell to -300 with no spikes event, and it stayed negative after coins were collected.
expected: Spikes cost 500 points, but the score never goes below 0 and is never negative. Score 100 minus a spike hit should give 0, not 65136 or -300.

title: Pause menu Resume button covered by toast, so it is not clickable
observed: After pausing, btn-resume reports top=false while the 'Key collected' toast is still visible. Something sits on top of the Resume button.
expected: Every visible button must be clickable and nothing may cover it. The Resume button in the pause menu must be on top.

title: HUD Coins stays at 0/5 after collecting a coin
observed: After dash-down collected a coin, state.coins is 1 but the HUD shows 'Coins 0/5' on the same tick and after the next tick.
expected: The HUD always shows the current coin count, so it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

title: HUD Time lags one tick behind the timer
observed: After resume, state.timeLeft is 299 but the HUD still shows 'Time 300'. The HUD keeps showing the previous value.
expected: The HUD shows the current ticks left on the timer, so it should read 'Time 299' to match state.timeLeft.

title: Spikes drive score to 65136 instead of clamping at 0
observed: At tick 2 the player on 100 points hits spikes; score becomes 65136 (100 - 500 wrapped as unsigned 16-bit) while lives correctly drop 3 to 2.
expected: Spikes cost 500 points but the score never goes below 0, so score should be 0 after the hit (max(100 - 500, 0)). Lives 3 to 2 is correct.

title: Score goes negative (-32746) on level completion after wrap
observed: Score wraps to 65136 after an earlier spike hit; the time bonus of 2590 then gives score -32746 at completion.
expected: Score is never negative and capped at 999,999; it should be a small positive value (about 32,790 plus bonus) with spikes clamped at 0.

title: Score silently drops from 65136 to -300 on a coin pickup
observed: At tick 8 a coin is collected with no spikes or restart, yet score goes from 65136 to -300.
expected: Score should only decrease through spikes or restart, and never below 0. A coin adds 100 to a valid score, so it should not drop at all.

title: Level-complete Finish button covered by overlay
observed: At tick 39, on the Level complete dialog, btn-next (Finish) is visible but top=false, so something (the bonus banner or toast) covers it and clicks would not reach it.
expected: Every visible button must be clickable; nothing may cover the Finish button.

title: Score negative (-32746) at level completion, same wrap bug
observed: Same sequence as the score overflow case: after an earlier spike wrap, the time bonus pushes score to -32746 at completion; Enter then shows victory with negative score.
expected: Score must stay within 0 to 999,999; spikes should clamp at 0 rather than wrap.

title: Score shows -300 after spike wrap and coin pickup
observed: Spikes at tick 3 turn score 100 into 65136; at tick 5 a coin then gives score -300.
expected: Score is never negative; spikes should clamp at 0 (score 0), and a coin adds 100 to a non-negative score.
